subject: Prospect requests pause: LLM pilot demo on hold
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira.k@noveline.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Noveline Procurement <procurement@noveline.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Jul 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Request to pause LLM pilot demo next week

Hi Grace / Marissa,

Quick note from the product team at Noveline — we've had a last-minute reprioritization. Our engineering leads have been pulled onto a security remediation sprint that conflicts directly with the pilot work we'd planned. As a result, we need to put the demo scheduled for next Tuesday on hold.

We still want to evaluate Redwood, but the timing won't work for the current sprint. Can you put the session on standby and share any materials we can review asynchronously? Procurement also asked that we hold off on any technical walkthroughs until the product team is back (likely in Q4 planning).

Apologies for the short notice — happy to sync briefly if helpful.

Thanks,
Samira Khan
Director of Product Ops | Noveline
samira.k@noveline.com

Attachments: Noveline_RFP_Q3.pdf

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@noveline.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 18 Jul 2027 17:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request to pause LLM pilot demo next week

Hi Samira —

Thanks for the heads up, and totally understand. We'll put the live demo on hold and mark the slot as pending. A few quick items we can do while the product team is focused on the security sprint:

- Share a short asynchronous demo recording and one-page cost/latency summary for your architects.
- Leave the technical agenda and mock data checklist intact so it's easy to rebook.
- Draft a brief mutual action plan that targets a Q4 re-engagement window — we can circulate dates once your planning solidifies.

I've attached the demo agenda and a draft MAP (mutual action plan) we typically use — no sensitive customer data. Karthik I'm looping in for any technical clarifications later.

If Noveline prefers an official hold date window, tell us where to park it (e.g., "resume contact in Oct week 2"). Otherwise we'll check in at the start of your Q4 planning cycle.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0128

Attachments: demo-agenda.docx (docx)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@noveline.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request to pause LLM pilot demo next week

Thanks for the update, Samira — understood on your side.

On our end we'll:
- Mark the calendar as "on hold" and not charge any demo slots.
- Keep the draft SOW and proposal materials ready; procurement, we won't proceed until you confirm.
- Grace/Karthik, let's agree to touch base the first week of Oct unless Noveline gives a different window.

Cc: Noveline Procurement <procurement@noveline.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request to pause LLM pilot demo next week

Thanks Grace — appreciate the quick response and the materials.

Our PM lead confirmed this morning: product bandwidth is committed to the security sprint through end of September. We should be able to revisit pilot conversations in early October when planning starts. For now, please keep the slot on hold and retain the proposal draft. Procurement will not sign or move forward until we have alignment with the product roadmap.

We'll plan to re-open the thread the week of Oct 4 — I'll send a note then with proposed dates. If anything changes earlier, I'll reach out.

Best,
Samira

Attachments: Noveline_RFP_Q3.pdf (pdf)
